answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 32656 Country: India Title: leg bone has extended from back of the ankle Question: My sister's mother in law has got her ankle back bone extended from behind and she gets alot of pain and she is suffering from much pain since many years and now that they have applied to go for haj this pain may occur and she might have lots of stress while tawaaf and all, i would specially request you all to send me the best dua through which she can feel better and normal as ever before .... please send the best dua for the lifetime for the pains in joints and bones.. Answer ID: 32656 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 975/809/B=1432) Recite the following dua seven times and blow on the place of pain: أسْأ لُ اللهَ العَظِيْمَ رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمَ أنْ يَّشْفِيَنِىْ. Also recite يا سلام يا سلام as much as you can. In-sha-Allah, the pain will vanish Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
